ISS-access.name: Login and account access failures
ISS-access.summary: Most reviews complain that users cannot log in, get logged out repeatedly, or cannot create or recover accounts, even after reinstalling the app.

ISS-billing.name: Forced premium paywall for features
ISS-billing.summary: Most reviews complain that core features like skipping, shuffle, and song selection are locked behind premium, and that ads and subscription pressure have increased.

ISS-catalog.name: Missing songs and lyrics
ISS-catalog.summary: Most reviews complain that certain songs, albums, or lyrics are unavailable or missing from the catalog, and that recommendations are poor.

ISS-downloads.name: Offline downloads not working
ISS-downloads.summary: Most reviews complain that downloaded music, podcasts, or playlists fail to play offline or cannot be downloaded at all.

ISS-other.name: General dissatisfaction with updates
ISS-other.summary: Most reviews are short, general complaints that the app has gotten worse with each update, with no specific feature named.

ISS-playback.name: Playback stops, stutters, or crashes
ISS-playback.summary: Most reviews complain that songs or podcasts cut out, stutter, or stop playing, and that the app crashes during playback.

ISS-support.name: Poor customer support responses
ISS-support.summary: Most reviews complain that customer support is slow, unhelpful, or unresponsive when users report problems.

ISS-usability.name: Ads and cluttered new interface
ISS-usability.summary: Most reviews complain that frequent ads and the redesigned interface make it hard to shuffle, queue, and find playlists and podcasts.
